visualCharacteristics.purpose: collapsible FAQ list where each question row expands to reveal its answer

contentPattern.structure: one row per FAQ item; cell 1 = question (heading or text), cell 2 = answer (rich text); a row with only a question renders as a non-expandable item

usage: FAQ sections on industry and service pages (about 40 pages), typically several questions stacked in one block.
reuseGuidance: Use for any question/answer or expandable-topic list. Use a fragment link in the answer cell only if the answer needs other blocks.
